text:
DeployBot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout for release r2026.03.15 started for service model-embed-service in eu-west-1. Traffic split 10% -> 90%. Monitoring enabled.
PagerDuty: Pager triggered: INC-73821 - model-embed-service canary 5xx spike (p95 latency up).
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty page fired, routed to on-call: Alex (rotation A). Escalation policy: 5m -> Samir -> Maria.
Alex: acked INC-73821 :white_check_mark: I'll take first look.
Alex: seeing a surge of 503/504 and p95 tokenization latency jumps on the canary pods. Dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/model-embed/eu-west-1/canary
Samir: reassigning to me for infra correlation, Maria please watch customer comms.
Maria: will check support tickets for errors correlated to this window.
Jin: looking at deploy logs — canary pod images r2026.03.15-embed-quant show new quant kernels. Kernel selection failed in 2 of 5 pods, container restarted. Here's the kube events tail:```
03/15 22:04:12 kubelet: Container runtime error: SIGSEGV in libquant.so
03/15 22:04:14 kubelet: Back-off restarting failed container
03/15 22:05:01 liveness probe failed (timeout)
```
Alex: this is consistent with memory allocation regressions from quant kernels. Impact: 10% traffic on canary -> approx 7% of total embed requests in eu-west-1 failing. Early estimate: <0.5% of total customers impacted but includes 3 paid customers with high-volume embeds.
Ops Runbook Bot: Runbook: "canary-failure-rollback" recommended. Steps: (1) pause rollout; (2) divert canary traffic; (3) roll back canary replicas to r2026.03.14; (4) notify customers.
Alex: pausing rollout now via DeployBot.
DeployBot: Rollout paused for model-embed-service in eu-west-1. Traffic split frozen at 10%.
Samir: I suggest immediate traffic diversion away from canary to avoid further customer errors while we decide. Can we set traffic to 0% for canary?
Alex: doing traffic divert -> DeployBot please shift canary traffic to 0%.
DeployBot: Applying traffic shift: canary -> 0%, baseline -> 100%. Command used:```
redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --service model-embed-service --region eu-west-1 --canary-percent 0 --reason "Canary 5xx spike"
```
DeployBot: Traffic update succeeded. Canary received 0% new traffic.
Maria: I've opened a prioritized customer impact ticket and pinged SRE on affected accounts. Drafting notification for the 3 customers: short update + ETA for mitigation.
Jin: capturing heap and core dumps from the two failing pods and uploading to debug bucket: gs://redwood-debug/INC-73821/ . Will attach analysis in a bit.
Samir: we should rollback the canary image to r2026.03.14 to be safe and redeploy when kernels are validated. Any objections?
Alex: agree. Rolling back canary to r2026.03.14.
DeployBot: Initiating canary rollback: setting canary image to r2026.03.14 and restarting canary replicaset. Command:```
redwoodctl rollout set-image --service model-embed-service --region eu-west-1 --image r2026.03.14 --canary
redwoodctl rollout restart --service model-embed-service --region eu-west-1 --canary
```
DeployBot: Canary rollback complete. New canary pods match baseline image r2026.03.14. Health checks passing.
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty INC-73821 acknowledged by Alex. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback and traffic diversion.
Alex: validating metrics: p95 latency returned to normal within 90s after divert; error budget for eu-west-1 back within SLOs.
Maria: customer notifications sent to the three impacted accounts; one reply already from ACME corp requesting an incident summary — I'll follow up with more details once we have postmortem.
Samir: root cause likely regression in quant kernel selection path introduced by r2026.03.15. Jin, can you confirm whether the kernel fallback path was exercised?
Jin: early signs show fallback didn't trigger because of a failing condition in the selector that assumed AVX512 presence. On debug dump: selector returned mismatched kernel id and libquant tried to dlopen a missing symbol. Filing a bug: BUG-1258.
Alex: good catch. Can we add a safety guard to the selector before re-deploying? Also add a quick smoke test in the CI to exercise kernel fallback on a small instance.
Samir: agreed. I'll own the rollback triage and merging a hotfix branch that adds guard + CI smoke. ETA for hotfix PR: ~2 hours. After hotfix lands we'll canary again at 5% with extended health checks and increased sample logging.
Maria: I'll schedule an incident follow-up meeting and set a short customer-facing summary for the status page.
Ops Runbook Bot: Next steps checklist appended to INC-73821: [divert traffic, rollback canary, collect dumps, create BUG-1258, hotfix PR, re-canary with extended checks, postmortem].
Alex: handing off monitoring and next steps to Samir (on-call for next 2 hours). I'll remain reachable for context. :handshake:
Samir: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor telemetry and the hotfix progress. If error rate resurfaces, I'll escalate to Maria and trigger PD escalation.
PagerDuty: No further pages for INC-73821 in last 10m. Auto-close scheduled if no regressions for 1h.
Jin: uploaded core analysis and initial patch notes to BUG-1258. Link: https://tracker.redwood/BUG-1258
Maria: thanks team. We'll keep support notified and prepare postmortem. Closing notes: quick detection and rollback minimized customer impact; follow-up required on kernel selector and CI coverage. :memo:
Alex: closing thread for the immediate incident. Reopen if we see a regression.
Oncall Bot: Thread closed by Alex. Incident status: mitigated.
